# MATLAB reference results

The MAT files below were moved unchanged from historical results on 2026-09-10.
They are inputs to `examples/compare_matlab_results.py`, not generated Python
outputs. No MATLAB installation or sibling repository is needed to read them.

| File | Source and data | Saved results |
|---|---|---|
| `matlab_simulation.mat` | Upstream MATLAB in KFV-FGO-Comparison-github, circle_cv_gmm_L4.mat | 100 epochs; KFV and ReFGO for EKF/iEKF/rEKF/riEKF; SWFGO windows 1/5/10 |
| `matlab_real.mat` | Integrated MATLAB in KFV-FGO-Comparison, urban_nav_deep | 438 epochs; KFV_EKF, ReFGO_EKF, SWFGO_w5 |

Select a result using `--matlab-key reference.runs.KFV_EKF`, replacing the final
name with another saved result when needed. `matlab_provenance.json` records
the original generation time, MATLAB version, MATLAB source hashes, input data
hashes, exact configurations and MAT file hashes. Historical absolute source
paths are provenance only, never runtime dependencies. All paths in the commands
below are relative to the Python workspace root.

```powershell
python examples/example_kfv_fgo_simulation.py
python examples/compare_matlab_results.py --matlab tests/fixtures/matlab_simulation.mat --matlab-key reference.runs.KFV_EKF --python results/kfv_fgo_simulation/KFV_EKF.npz --output results/compare_simulation

python examples/example_sw_fgo_simulation.py --window 5 --iterations 1 --kernel none
python examples/compare_matlab_results.py --matlab tests/fixtures/matlab_simulation.mat --matlab-key reference.runs.SWFGO_w5 --python results/sw_fgo_simulation/SWFGO_w5.npz --output results/compare_simulation_swfgo

python examples/example_kfv_fgo_real.py --modes EKF
python examples/compare_matlab_results.py --matlab tests/fixtures/matlab_real.mat --matlab-key reference.runs.KFV_EKF --python results/kfv_fgo_real/KFV_EKF.npz --output results/compare_real

python examples/example_sw_fgo_real.py --window 5 --iterations 5 --kernel huber
python examples/compare_matlab_results.py --matlab tests/fixtures/matlab_real.mat --matlab-key reference.runs.SWFGO_w5 --python results/sw_fgo_real/SWFGO_w5.npz --output results/compare_real_swfgo
```

Use a fresh comparison output directory for each run. The real SWFGO reference
uses Huber delta 1, unlike the example's default kernel `none`. The simulation
SWFGO reference uses one iteration and no robust kernel. Python ReFGO templates
delegate to KFV; their agreement is not evidence of independent FGO solvers.

## Intermediate-value regression fixture

`matlab_reference.npz` is a separate, older reference used by regression tests:

Historical fixture generated by the previous KFV-FGO-Comparison-python workspace's
`tools/validate_matlab_reference.m` (relative to this folder:
`../../../../KFV-FGO-Comparison-python/tools/validate_matlab_reference.m`) using the unmodified sibling
`KFV-FGO-Comparison` commit 4451a38, MATLAB R2026a, MatRTKLIB/MALIB commit
159e150d4a54e6b7b15d81128289b8559523ca81, on 2026-09-09.
Contains all four simulation and real KFV/Re-FGO trajectories, real sliding
windows 1/5/10 (five iterations, Huber delta 1), the first three update debug
records, and GNSS/IMU model probes. No MATLAB runtime is needed to read it.
Default data: circle_cv_gmm_L4.mat and urban_nav_deep (438 epochs).
Regenerate only when deliberately changing the reference; do not regenerate
from Python test outputs to make a failing comparison pass.

This generator is historical provenance, not a runtime or test dependency.
The current examples/compare_matlab_results.py reads saved result files only;
it never launches MATLAB or regenerates this fixture.
